name: Blaupunkt
verdict: Consumer-electronics brand owned since 2023 by Established. Inc., a US brand-licensing company backed by Ares Management and Crosstimbers Capital. Nothing found.
note: Iron Lynx partner since 2025 (team's own 'Iron Lynx joins Blaupunkt for 2026 IFA Berlin' news, 2026-08-31). The Blaupunkt brand is a licensing platform: products are made by licensees. Acquired by Established. Inc. from GIP Development (AURELIUS) in June 2023.
